statement: Every full source continuation with at least9 short-sheet originals satisfies the audited parent. Project away its vertical-cell variables and delete their channeling and area capacities. Every remaining variable and constraint is unchanged except internal interval reference renumbering. Thus any source continuation still satisfies this weaker geometry projection. A negative excludes the same count subfamily; a positive must restore/check all omitted band capacities and full original geometry. All66 identity obligations and the first-sheet complement remain unchanged.
